'''''Lathir''''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that acted as a [[Flagship/Legends|command vessel]]. It was one of the closest to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], and was used to transfer [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] captured from [[Whisper Base]].
